task.question: How many years was it since DR Congo last appeared in the FIFA World Cup before their knockout stage match against England on July 1, 2026?
task.evidence: Although DR Congo were eliminated, this marked their best-ever finish in the FIFA World Cup upon their return after 52 years.

answer:
Perfect! Now I have the information I need. Let me verify the calculation:

- DR Congo last appeared in the FIFA World Cup in 1974 (as Zaire)
- They appeared again in 2026
- The match against England was on July 1, 2026
- Years between 1974 and 2026 = 2026 - 1974 = 52 years

FINAL: 52

They won the Africa Cup of Nations twice (in 1968 as Congo-Kinshasa and in 1974 as Zaire), and were the first Sub-Saharan African team to qualify for the FIFA World Cup, as Zaire in 1974.
